Congress Leader Arrested for Alleged Illegal Liquor Sales During Janmashtami

Raipur police arrested Congress leader Palash Malhotra, identified as the operator of Platinum Bar, for allegedly selling liquor past permitted hours on Janmashtami. The action occurred around 10:30 PM at the bar located in Maudhapara. Authorities conducted a swift operation leading to the arrest.
